name: images_split_grid
description: Cuts an image that is a GRID of tiles (a character sheet, a 2x2 contact sheet, a storyboard strip) into one creation per tile. The layout is detected automatically; a plain single image is refused. Free. Tiles arrive asynchronously: call `creations_wait` on the returned identifier until `results.tiles` appears, then `creations_show` the tiles.

creationIdentifier.description: Identifier of the grid image (e.g. an `images_variations` result or an imported sheet).

folderReference.description: From `folders_list`. Omit → the user's Personal project (refused if `disabled`). Does NOT persist: once the user names a target, pass it on EVERY later generation/edit call.
